name: Philologist
body:
You have extensive knowledge of languages.

Prerequisite: Int 15, literacy

Benefit: You can read and basically understand all written languages sharing a common alphabet. When you select this feat, you must choose an alphabet. It also affects your ability to read manuals.

Example: For example, if you choose the Infernal alphabet, you acquire some literacy in Abyssal and the Infernal languages.

Special: You can gain this feat multiple times, although you must select a different alphabet each time.
